coverage.description: Mapped currently populated place names in the GeoNames Nigeria country snapshot, including cities, towns, villages, farm/religious villages, populated localities, administrative seats and sections of populated places. This is separate from the administrative LGA/Area Council catalog.
coverage.limitations: GeoNames provides data as is without warranties of accuracy, timeliness or completeness. This snapshot is not a complete authoritative register of every Nigerian city and does not prove an address or residence. 310 current populated-place records have no recognized State/FCT code and are excluded rather than assigned by guesswork. Same-name places within a state share one selection. Upstream primary names, including an unusual comma-bearing locality name, are preserved; no manual geographical corrections or alternate-name additions were invented.

transformation.deduplication: Primary name column 1, Unicode NFC and surrounding whitespace trim; case-folded name per state; first lowest numeric GeoName ID retained; names sorted by Unicode case-folded code-point order.

runtime: Local static dataset only. No runtime GeoNames request, API key, paid service, user coordinates or account data transmission.
